policy.shared_bundle_rule: A Brain/Core provider mutation must be compatible with every supported official Nuvio client generation because the published provider bundle is shared across clients.
policy.selection_rule: Prefer runtime capability detection inside generated provider code; use client version/ref gates only when a behavior cannot be detected safely at runtime.
policy.unknown_generation: fail-closed for automatic mutation capabilities not proven on the baseline generation
policy.reader_only_drift: may require native reader re-proof without invalidating provider-only capabilities
policy.provider_contract_drift: blocks automatic Brain provider mutation until audited
policy.client_runtime_equivalence: Never infer runtime compatibility from a sibling client. Desktop, Mobile and TV must each execute the shared provider/Core bundle in their own official runtime; success on one client is evidence for that client only.
policy.runtime_error_observability: Official clients may intentionally collapse getStreams JavaScript exceptions into an empty result for application resilience. Native Labs must preserve those exceptions as diagnostic evidence and must not classify the resulting empty application value as a successful runtime execution.
policy.cross_client_divergence: A single provider/client discrepancy remains Brain evidence. A systematic client-wide empty/runtime-error pattern while an official peer succeeds is a blocking runtime-contract failure.
policy.client_session_lifecycle_faults: Cross-work stream loading exhaustion or recovery after restarting the client is client-runtime lifecycle evidence, never provider disablement proof by itself.
policy.media_identity_contract: The positional getStreams(tmdbId, mediaType, season, episode) argument is transport, not the full media identity. NiakVIO's canonical IMDb metadata path is __nuvioMediaContext.tmdbMetadata.external_ids.imdb_id and its shared metadata cache is __nuvioTmdbMetadataCacheV1. Equivalent client hydration is allowed, but no end-user TMDB credential may be required and no TMDB secret may be projected into provider JavaScript solely to recover IMDb identity.

media_type_boundary.series_capability_meaning: client/input/family reasoning capability only; never a published supportedTypes value

policy.provider_execution_isolation: Mobile/Desktop execute each plugin in a fresh QuickJS runtime; reuse-last-link cache carries addon identity; manual stream selection bypasses cache reuse; automatic fallback must replace active provider name/id together with the source.
policy.tv_provider_execution_isolation: NuvioTV creates a fresh QuickJS runtime per scraper execution, preserves plugin source identity through repository grouping, never auto-falls back a user-picked source, updates current addon identity when switching sources, and refreshes expired links only within the same addon.

provider_contract.runtime_validation: execute the exact official Mobile runtime/distribution; Desktop success is not Mobile proof
provider_contract.official_getStreams_error_behavior: application runtime catches JavaScript getStreams errors and captures []
provider_contract.lab_error_policy: diagnostic runtime trap preserves swallowed errors before collection/cross-client gates
provider_contract.surface_note: Mobile and Desktop currently share several runtime bridge subtrees, but their PluginRuntime/JsBindings/network sources are independently versioned and must be diffed separately.
provider_contract.audited_change: 2026-11-17 exact source re-audit at cmp-rewrite dd0e84704df5: no provider/plugin/streams contract path changed. The only semantic-review-path delta is a two-line Watch Party privacy guard that refuses to share signed media-server streams carrying headers; normal getStreams invocation, full result mapping, request/response headers, subtitle headers and runtime TMDB_API_KEY bridge remain unchanged. Android/iOS reader execution remains independently required.
provider_contract.identity_hydration_note: Current Mobile HostFunctions exposes __get_tmdb_api_key and JsBindings assigns globalThis.TMDB_API_KEY from TmdbSettingsRepository.effectiveApiKey(); that resolver falls back to the build TmdbConfig.API_KEY. NiakVIO Core can therefore hydrate its own TMDB/IMDb metadata cache without embedding a key in provider bytes. The client still does not supply __nuvioMediaContext or __nuvioCoreGetTmdbDataV1 directly.

provider_contract.surface_note: Desktop and Mobile current branches share byte-identical PluginModels and common runtime bridge shapes, but exact native execution remains independently versioned and must still be proven on macOS and Windows.
provider_contract.session_lifecycle_note: Cancelling the UI/request coroutine is not proof that an already-entered native QuickJS/fetch execution was torn down. Late/stuck work across media navigation is compatibility evidence only.

NiakVIO Core can hydrate its own bounded TMDB/IMDb cache without embedding a key in provider bytes. No __nuvioMediaContext/__nuvioCoreGetTmdbDataV1 host object is supplied directly.
